notes: 'shall he go again' was divided with 'again' on the finite verb of returning and 'go' on the infinitive, which is what each morpheme is rendered by; the lāmed before the infinitive is unrepresented, since no function word is written for it (rules 40, 52).
məʾûmâ and lōʾ share the single word 'nothing', headed on the negative (rule 35).
'his mother's womb' puts the possessive determiner on the suffix, since an English possessive takes the determiner of the possessor (rule 29).
